# Quantum Mechanics — Complex Vectors and Measurements

Book Chapter 9 uses Dirac notation and quantum mechanics to apply inner products and linear transformations in a complex vector space.

## Follow the chapters

1. [dirac notation](01-dirac-notation.qmd)
2. [unitary operators](02-unitary-operators.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Quantum Mechanics — Complex Vectors and Measurements. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
